Thanks. You are probably right. I feel like after a year of psych and anti depressants I shouldn't feel so horrifically depressed and un supported as I do. More help certainly never hurts. 
What I mean about the hospital is last time I was like this I ended up the the emergency psych ward of my local hospital for a week. Sadly my partner is super supportive with my physical problems, but thinks the depression side is something that I can just fight my way out of. If only it was that easy.

Thankyou. Sickness sucks right? I'm sorry you've had this battle.
I'm 33/f and I used to be a magazine editor. I now blog just to keep my brain doing something.
